common.jsonlHint: One JSON object per line (JSON Lines), the format the export endpoint produces.

overview.title: Governance loop
overview.description: One governed knowledge base: semantics define what questions mean, ingestion is approved before it becomes knowledge, the golden set gates every change, and the query facade answers with a trace.
overview.noProject: No governance project yet. Create one through the API or the seed script.
overview.rulesCardDescription: Intent rules route every question to a strategy.
overview.rulesWaitingGate: A proposed rule set is waiting for a passing evaluation.
overview.ingestCardDescription: Batches land staged; approval publishes them.
overview.goldenCardDescription: The frozen yardstick every change must beat.
overview.evalCardDescription: Replays the golden set against the knowledge base.
overview.approvalsCardDescription: Staged data becomes knowledge only here.
overview.queryCardDescription: Ask; the answer carries its full trace.
overview.queryReady: Rules are active — questions are answered under governance.
overview.queryNotReady: Rules are not active yet; governed queries need an active rule set.

rules.title: Intent rules
rules.description: The project's semantics: each rule matches a question to an intent and a strategy — retrieval only, live tools, an agentic plan, or a refusal. A set is proposed, must clear an evaluation, then activates.
rules.empty: No rule set yet. Propose one below.
rules.setsDescription: Activating a set archives the previous one; history stays addressable.
rules.activeDescription: These rules decide every governed query right now.
rules.previewDescription: Type a question and see which intent and strategy the active or candidate rules would pick. Nothing is stored.
rules.questionPlaceholder: e.g. 应收 90 天以上占比多少？
rules.proposeDescription: A JSON array of rules (the server's IntentRule schema). Proposing never activates: an evaluation must pass first.
rules.proposedToast: Rule set proposed; run an evaluation to unlock activation.
rules.activateDescription: Activation requires a passing evaluation run of the current confirmed golden set.
rules.activateMissing: Pick a passing evaluation run first.
rules.nothingToActivate: Nothing to activate: propose a rule set first.

sources.title: Sources & ingestion
sources.description: Durable inputs and their ingestion batches. A batch lands staged — invisible to queries — until the approval gate publishes it.
sources.createDescription: Every .md/.txt file under the path becomes a document with a stable logical id (its relative path).
sources.ingestAcceptedToast: Ingest queued; watch the batch below.
sources.batchesDescription: The review state machine, newest first.
sources.batchesEmpty: No batch yet. Trigger an ingest above.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: The gate between staged data and the knowledge base. Every decision is append-only, with a comment and an actor.
approvals.queueDescription: Select a batch to inspect exactly what approval would publish.
approvals.stagedDescription: Unpublished rows, visible only with the staged:read capability — this is what the gate withholds.
approvals.commentPlaceholder: Why this batch is (not) fit to become knowledge

golden.title: Golden sets
golden.description: Versioned test cases with expected intent, strategy, sources and numeric facts. Confirmed sets are immutable — editing forks the next version.
golden.empty: No golden set yet. Import or generate one below.
golden.setsDescription: Select a row to see its cases.
golden.casesDescription: What each run must reproduce: the intent, the strategy, the citations, the facts.
golden.question: Question
golden.forkedToast: Forked as version {{version}}; edit and confirm it when ready.
golden.importDescription: One case per line — the same format the export endpoint produces.
golden.importedToast: Imported {{count}} case(s) as a candidate set.
golden.generateAcceptedToast: Generation queued; a candidate set will appear in the list.

evals.title: Evaluations
evals.description: A run replays a confirmed golden set against the knowledge base and records pass/fail per case. Rule activation requires a passing run.
evals.startDescription: Baseline proves the corpus; change proves an edit.
evals.startedToast: Evaluation queued; the run appears below.

query.title: Governed query
query.description: Ask the governed knowledge base. The answer arrives with its full trace: matched intent, strategy, rule version, citations and tool calls.
query.notActive: This project is "{{status}}" — governed queries need an active rule set.
query.askDescription: The rule set decides the strategy; clearance and scopes filter what may be retrieved or called.
query.questionPlaceholder: Ask anything within the governed scope…
query.observationsDescription: Every behaviour above produced this trace.
